root_cause.text: In Bluetooth `hci_sync.c`, `hci_adv_bcast_annoucement()` prepended Broadcast Announcement service data to `adv->adv_data` without validating that `adv->adv_data_len + len` fit in the fixed temporary buffer `ad`, causing a buffer overrun when an existing advertising instance already used the maximum payload.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `if (adv->adv_data_len > sizeof(ad) - len) { bt_dev_err(hdev, "No room for Broadcast Announcement"); return -EINVAL; }` immediately before `memcpy(ad + len, adv->adv_data, adv->adv_data_len);`, and the CVE/commit text explicitly states that the combined data "may no longer fit in the temporary buffer used to rebuild the advertising data" and that the fix avoids "overrunning the temporary buffer."
